item.title: PM Skills Weekly — Issue 30
item.description:
Your weekly minute on doing professional work with AI — one skill to master, a few to try, and the numbers.
## 🌟 Skill of the week: Metrics Framework Build a metrics framework for any product, team, or business. **→ [Run it free](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=metrics-framework)** · `metrics-framework` · ✅ 4.8/5
## 🔥 Fresh picks - **[Exam Prep Planner](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=exam-prep-planner)** — Build a realistic exam-prep schedule with spaced repetition and retrieval practice — the plan that survives contact with an actual week. - **[Expense Audit](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=expense-audit)** — Audit spending to find leaks — recurring subscriptions, creep, and cuttable costs — ranked by impact. - **[Feature Prioritisation](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/?skill=feature-prioritisation)** — Apply prioritisation frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano, ICE, Opportunity Scoring) to rank features and backlog items.
## 📊 By the numbers **630** professional skills · **87** bundles · **28** eval-scored (avg 4.4/5).
